verdict.rationale: Rippling explicitly claims integration with QuickBooks, Xero, and NetSuite for accounting sync (rippling-docs-14), but the evidence pack lacks detail on how payroll journal entries specifically sync (e.g., mapping, frequency, automation depth) or any independent/hands-on confirmation of this working in practice. missing for 10: detailed documentation of journal entry mapping/configuration, evidence of automatic sync frequency, and independent or community corroboration that the QuickBooks/Xero sync works reliably.
